result.finding: Oracle Database Free (23ai) is the only external system dependency. It serves as both the relational database for photo metadata and binary BLOB storage for photo image data. No other external systems (caches, queues, auth services, file storage) are used.
evidence: docker-compose.yml: oracle-db service using gvenzl/oracle-free:latest (Oracle Database Free 23ai)
Photo entity: @Lob byte[] photoData stored directly in Oracle BLOB column
README.md: prerequisites include Oracle DB container setup
No Redis, Memcached, Kafka, RabbitMQ, LDAP, S3, Azure Blob, or other external system references
values: Oracle Database Free 23ai (relational DB + BLOB storage)
Purpose: photo metadata storage + binary image data (BLOB)
